'''Route Mobile''' (formerly Routesms Solutions Ltd) is an Indian [[cloud communications]] platform as a service (CPaaS) company. Started in 2004 and headquartered in [[Mumbai]], the company has presence in more than 15 locations across [[Asia-Pacific]], [[Middle East]], [[Africa]], [[Europe]] and [[North America]].<ref>{{cite news |date=22 January 2018 |title=Route Mobile files IPO papers with SEBI, to raise around Rs 600 cr |work=[[Moneycontrol.com]] |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/ipo/route-mobile-files-ipo-papers-with-sebi-to-raise-around-rs-600-cr-2488475.html}}</ref>

==History==
Route Mobile was started in [[Mumbai]] in May 2004 as a [[cloud communications]] platform provider for [[Over-the-top media service|over the top]] (OTT) and [[mobile network operators]] (MNO).<ref>{{cite news|last1=Banerjee|first1=Prasid|date=6 November 2019|title=WhatsApp snooping: Is RCS answer to government's localisation problems?|language=en|work=[[Mint (newspaper)|Mint]]|url=https://www.livemint.com/technology/apps/whatsapp-snooping-is-rcs-answer-to-government-s-localisation-problems-11573055069439.html}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|date=28 July 2019|title=Multiple numbers on a single SIM? Yes, it's possible!|language=en|work=[[Deccan Chronicle]]|url=https://www.deccanchronicle.com/technology/in-other-news/280719/multiple-numbers-on-a-single-sim-yes-its-possible.html}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|date=28 July 2019|title=Temporary virtual numbers may increase safety of users|language=en|work=[[Times Now]]|url=https://www.timesnownews.com/technology-science/article/temporary-virtual-numbers-may-increase-safety-of-users/460191}}</ref> It partnered with companies including [[Idea Cellular]],<ref name="economictimes">{{cite news|last1=Gupta|first1=Deepali|title=Idea Cellular looks to plug revenue leakage|work=[[The Economic Times]]|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/telecom/telecom-news/idea-cellular-looks-to-plug-revenue-leakage/articleshow/65556572.cms}}</ref> [[Lanka Bell]], and Arab Financials Services for providing messaging services in [[India]], [[Sri Lanka]], Middle East and North Africa region.<ref>{{cite news|date=11 March 2020|title=Route Mobile partners with Lanka Bell|language=en|work=[[Business Line]]|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/route-mobile-partners-with-lanka-bell/article31040724.ece}}</ref>

In May 2017, Route Mobile acquired Call 2 Connect, an [[Outsourcing|ITES]] provider based out of India.<ref>{{Cite news|last=Gupta|first=Deepali|date=9 May 2017|title=Route Mobile acquires BPO Call2Connect|work=[[The Economic Times]]|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/deals/route-mobile-acquires-bpo-call2connect/articleshow/58584093.cms?from=mdr|access-date=2020-07-29}}</ref> In the same year, Route Mobile acquired 365squared, a SMS [[Firewall (computing)|firewall]] company based out of [[Malta]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Gupta|first1=Deepali|date=20 September 2017|title=Route Mobile to buy Malta-based 365squared|work=[[The Economic Times]]|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/hardware/route-mobile-to-buy-malta-based-365squared/articleshow/60760011.cms?from=mdr}}</ref><ref name="economictimes1">{{cite news|title=Route Mobile to grow through strategic acquisitions – Times of India|language=en|work=[[The Times of India]]|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/route-mobile-to-grow-through-strategic-acquisitions/articleshow/70214555.cms}}</ref>

In July 2023, it was announced that [[Belgium|Belgian]] telecommunications company [[Proximus Group]] would be taking a majority stake in Route Mobile through its daughter holding Opal.<ref>{{cite news|date=17 July 2023|title=Proximus legt 643 miljoen euro op tafel voor meerderheidsbelang in Indiaas techbedrijf|language=nl|work=VRT NWS|url=https://www.vrt.be/vrtnws/nl/2023/07/17/proximus-legt-643-miljoen-euro-op-tafel-voor-meerderheidsbelang/}}</ref> On May 8, 2024, it was announced that this transaction had been completed.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.proximus.com/news/2024/20240508-proximus-set-to-become-a-world-leading-player-in-digital-communications.html#|title=Proximus Group completes the acquisition of a majority stake in Route Mobile|work=Proximus Group|date=2024-05-08|access-date=2024-05-29|language=en}}</ref>

==Recognition==
* 2019: The Best Messaging Innovation – Consumer Solution Award at Messaging and SMS Global Awards, [[London]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Winners of the 2019 Messaging and SMS Global Awards named|url=https://www.capacitymedia.com/articles/3824606/the-winners-of-the-2019-messaging-and-sms-global-awards-are-announced|access-date=2020-07-28|website=www.capacitymedia.com|date=3 December 2019 |language=en}}</ref>
* 2019: The Fastest Growing Indian Technology and Telecom Company Award in [[UK]] at [[India]] Meets Britain Tracker 2019.<ref name="indiatimes">{{cite news|title=Indian investment in UK on rise despite Brexit: Report|work=[[The Economic Times]]|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/economy/foreign-trade/indian-investment-in-uk-on-rise-despite-brexit-report/articleshow/69042421.cms?from=mdr}}</ref>
* 2020: Among the most fastest growing companies in [[Technology]] & Telecom sector and overall 2nd in the UK's top fastest growing Indian companies in the [[United Kingdom]] 2020.<ref name="businessworld">{{cite news|title=Route Mobile [UK] Limited Stands Overall 2nd In UK's Top Fastest-Growing Indian Companies List|language=en|work=[[Businessworld]]|url=http://www.businessworld.in/article/Route-Mobile-UK-Limited-Stands-Overall-2nd-In-UK-s-Top-Fastest-Growing-Indian-Companies-List/14-05-2020-192108/}}</ref>
* 2019: The Best Governed Company in the unlisted segment (Emerging Category) award at the 19th ICSI National Award for [[Corporate governance]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=ICSI National Awards For Excellence In Corporate Governance Held In New Delhi|url=http://businessworld.in/article/ICSI-National-Awards-For-Excellence-In-Corporate-Governance-Held-In-New-Delhi/14-01-2020-182036|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2020-07-28|website=[[Businessworld]]|language=en}}</ref>
